1778-3967-5006-8170.easyPrerequisites: You haven't cast a spell using Lurrus this turn if Memnite is starting in your graveyard.
1778-3967-5006-8170.description:
Cast Memnite by paying {0}.
Flickering Hound triggers, blinking Lurrus.
Resolve the Memnite spell. Then, activate Yahenni by sacrificing Memnite, giving Yahenni indestructible until end of turn
Repeat.

619-2645-2930-3430.easyPrerequisites: Portent Tracker doesn't have summoning sickness.
619-2645-2930-3430.description:
Activate Dormant Volcano by tapping it, adding {C}{C}{C}{R}{R}{R} due to Nyxbloom Ancient
Activate Portent Tracker by tapping it, untapping Dormant Volcano
Activate Staff of Domination's third ability by paying {3} and tapping it, untapping Portent Tracker.
Activate Staff of Domination's first ability by paying {1}, untapping it.
Repeat.

3967-4694-6258-7306.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature with a +1/+1 counter on it.
3967-4694-6258-7306.description:
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing a creature with a +1/+1 counter on it.
When that creature dies, The Ooze triggers, creating a Mutagen artifact token for each +1/+1 counter on the sacrificed creature. These artifacts are also 0/0 creatures due to March of the Machines.
Each Mutagen artifact creature token enters with at least one +1/+1 counter on it due to Thunderous Velocipede.
Resolve the Yahenni ability, giving them indestructible until end of turn.
Repeat from step 1.

386-2822.easyPrerequisites:
Your commander is on the battlefield and doesn't have summoning sickness.
Glistening Oil is attached to your commander.
386-2822.notablePrerequisites:
Your commander has power 10 or greater.
An opponent cannot block your commander.
386-2822.description:
Deal combat damage to an opponent using your commander, which will get at least ten poison counters due to its infect. This will cause the opponent to lose the game due to having ten or more poison counters.
Kediss triggers, causing your commander to give each other opponent at least ten poison counters due to its infect. This will cause each opponent to lose the game due to having ten or more poison counters.

803-2366-6495-6879.easyPrerequisites:
You are able to play a land this turn.
"[Type]" chosen with Arcane Adaptation.
803-2366-6495-6879.description:
Play Dryad Arbor.
When Dryad Arbor enters as an Ally due to Arcane Adaptation, Haru triggers, earthbending Dryad Arbor.
Activate Dryad Arbor by tapping it, adding {G}.
Activate Evereth by sacrificing Dryad Arbor.
When Dryad Abor dies, Haru triggers, returning Dryad Arbor from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Dryad Arbor enters as an Ally due to Arcane Adaptation, Haru triggers, earthbending Dryad Arbor.
Resolve the Evereth ability.
Repeat from step 3.
803-2366-6495-6879.notes: If you have a way to kill Evereth and {1}{B/R} available, you can do so after putting a significant amount of +1/+1 counters on it to deal damage to each opponent using its second ability.

710-4247-4775.description:
Activate Bloodthrone Vampire by sacrificing Danitha
When Danitha dies, Necrogen Communion triggers, returning Danitha from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When Danitha enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Necrogen Communion from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to Danitha.
Resolve the Bloodthrone Vampire ability.
Repeat.

240-955-3899-5470.description:
Activate Atla by paying {2} and tapping it, creating an 0/1 Egg creature token with defender.
Activate a nontoken creature you control using the ability granted to it by Ghired by tapping it, creating a copy of the Egg token.
Activate Spawning Pit by sacrificing an Egg token.
When the Egg dies, Atla triggers, causing you to reveal cards from the top of your library until you reveal a creature card and put it onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Spawning Pit ability, putting a charge counter on Spawning Pit
Repeat from step 2.

586-864-2267-3125-4050.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature.
586-864-2267-3125-4050.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar twice by sacrificing Priest of Gix and Eternal Witness.
Cast Victimize by paying {2}{B} and sacrificing another creature, returning Eternal Witness and Priest of Gix from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Priest of Gix and Eternal Witness enter, they each trigger as well as Tormod.
Resolve the Priest of Gix trigger, adding {B}{B}{B}.
Resolve the Tormod trigger, creating a creature token
Resolve the Eternal Witness trigger, returning Victimize from your graveyard to your hand.
Tormod triggers, creating a creature token
Repeat.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

2511-6972-7933.description:
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing Cold-Blooded Crew.
When Cold-Blooded Crew dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When Cold-Blooded Crew enters, it triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability.
Repeat.

1636-5627-7893.notablePrerequisites:
Wight of the Reliquary does not have summoning sickness.
You control at least one additional creature.
1636-5627-7893.description:
Activate Wight of the Reliquary by tapping it and sacrificing another creature, causing you to search your library for a land card and put it onto the battlefield tapped.
When the land enters the battlefield, Thranduil, Sindarin Liege triggers, creating a creature token.
When the creature token enters the battlefield, Intruder Alarm triggers, untapping all creatures.
Repeat.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

2762-2829-6972.easyPrerequisites: You are able to kill Arcbound Ravager such that it won't have a -1/-1 counter on it when it dies.
2762-2829-6972.description:
Activate Arcbound Ravager by sacrificing Thopter Squadron.
When Thopter Squadron dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a -1/-1 counter on it due to its replacement effect.
Resolve the Arcbound Ravager ability.
Repeat.
Kill Arcbound Ravager.
When Arcbound Ravager dies, its persist ability triggers, returning Arcbound Ravager from your graveyard to the battlefield. It will have no counters on it due to its modular ability.
Arcbound Ravager dies as a state-based action due to having 0 toughness
Repeat from step 2.
2762-2829-6972.notes: This combo will end the game in a draw if it isn't interacted with, as it creates a mandatory infinite loop.

1563-1879-2457-7810.description:
Activate Ant Queen by paying {1}{G}, creating two tokens.
Activate the tokens by tapping them, adding {G}{G}.
Repeat

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to any other creature you control

1322-3010-3259.notablePrerequisites: At least one opponent cannot block creatures you control.
1322-3010-3259.description:
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached and Moonblade Shinobi, triggering Breath of Fury and Moonblade Shinobi.
Resolve the Moonblade Shinobi trigger, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Breath of Fury trigger, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to a creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one. 
Repeat each combat phase.

670-1619-3742-6146.notablePrerequisites: You are currently venturing in Tomb of Annihilation in the Trapped Entry room.
670-1619-3742-6146.description:
Cast Phantom Steed by paying its mana cost.
When Phantom Steed enters, it and Radiant Solar trigger.
Resolve the Phantom Steed trigger, exiling Ravenloft Adventurer until Phantom Steed leaves the battlefield.
Resolve the Radiant Solar trigger, venturing into the Oubliette room, causing you to discard a card and then sacrifice Phantom Steed.
Phantom Steed leaves the battlefield, causing Ravenloft Adventurer to be returned to the battlefield from exile.
When Ravenloft Adventurer enters, it and Radiant Solar trigger.
Resolve the Ravenloft Adventurer trigger, venturing into the Cradle of the Death God room, creating a 4/4 legendary The Atropal creature token and completing Tomb of Annihilation.
If you control two or more The Atropal tokens, put all but one into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Sefris' second ability triggers, returning Phantom Steed from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Phantom Steed enters, it and Radiant Solar trigger.
Resolve the Phantom Steed trigger, exiling Ravenloft Adventurer until Phantom Steed leaves the battlefield.
Resolve the Radiant Solar trigger from step 10, venturing into Tomb of Annihilation and into the Trapped Entry room, causing each player to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Radiant Solar trigger from step 6, venturing into the Oubliette room, causing you to discard a card and then sacrifice Phantom Steed.
Repeat from step 5.

2173-4771-5220-7452.description:
Activate Myr Scrapling by sacrificing it.
When Myr Scrapling dies, Mortuary and Cauldron of Essence trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Myr Scrapling from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Cauldron of Essence trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Myr Scrapling ability.
Cast Myr Scrapling from the top of your library by paying 1 life.
Repeat.

uses.n: Etali, Primal Conqueror // Etali, Primal Sickness

575-4050-4294-7115.description:
Cast Etali either from your hand or the command zone by paying {5}{R}{R} plus commander tax if applicable.
When Etali enters, it triggers.
Holding priority, activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Etali.
When Etali dies, Yedora triggers, returning Etali from your graveyard to the battlefield face-down as a Forest land.
Holding priority, activate Etali by tapping it, adding {G}.
Resolve the Etali trigger from step 2, exiling cards from the top of each library until each player has exiled a nonland card, and causing you to cast any number of those cards without paying its mana cost.
For each card cast, Toph's second ability triggers once.
Resolve the first Toph trigger, earthbending Etali.
Resolve any remaining triggers, earthbending any other lands you desire. If you do not want to earthbend other lands, target Etali with all remaining triggers.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Etali.
When Etali dies, Toph and Yedora trigger.
Resolve the Yedora trigger, choosing not to return Etali.
Resolve the Toph trigger, returning Etali from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
Repeat from step 2.

2558-3000-3698-6737.description:
Cast Sword of the Meek by paying {2}.
When Sword of the Meek enters, Grinding Station and Barret's first ability triggers.
Resolve the Grinding Station trigger, untapping it.
Holding priority, activate Grinding Station by tapping it and sacrificing Sword of the Meek.
Holding priority, activate Grinding Station by sacrificing Sword of the Meek.
Resolve the Barret trigger, creating a 2/2 Rebel creature token and a 1/1 Squirrel creature token due to Chatterfang.
When the Squirrel enters, Sword of the Meek triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to the Squirrel.
Repeat from step 2.

1563-2457-2557-4742.description:
Activate Ant Queen by paying {1}{G}, creating two creature tokens.
Activate the tokens by tapping them, adding {G}{G}.
Repeat

104-2557-4659-5086-5183.easyPrerequisites: Triskelavus has two or more +1/+1 counters on it.
104-2557-4659-5086-5183.description:
Activate Triskelavus by paying {1} and removing a +1/+1 counter from it, creating two creature tokens.
Activate a Triskelavite token by sacrificing it, dealing 1 damage to any target and causing you to gain life.
Cleric Class triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Triskelavus
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing another creature token, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat from step 1.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with two or more charge counters on it

539-3129-3789-3899-4552.description:
Animate Spawning Pit using The Blackstaff of Waterdeep.
Activate Spawning Pit's second ability by removing two charge counters from it, creating two creature tokens.
Activate Spawning Pit's first ability twice by sacrificing the creature tokens, putting two charge counters on it.
Repeat from step 2.

883-2438-5220-6900.description:
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing it.
When Carrion Feeder dies, Mortuary and Ashes of the Abhorrent trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Carrion Feeder from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Ashes of the Abhorrent trigger, causing you to gain 1 life
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability.
Cast Carrion Feeder from the top of your library by paying 1 life.
Repeat.

Activate Marwyn by tapping it, adding at least {G}{G}{G}.
Activate Voltaic Construct by paying {2}, untapping Marwyn.

2558-3000-5315-5727.description:
Cast Sword of the Meek by paying {2}.
When Sword of the Meek enters the battlefield, The Prydwen triggers.
Holding priority, activate Ravenous Intruder by sacrificing Sword of the Meek.
Resolve the Prydwen trigger, creating a 2/2 Human Knight and a 1/1 Squirrel creature token.
When the Squirrel enters the battlefield, Sword of the Meek triggers, returning Sword of the Meek from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to the Soldier.
Repeat from step 2.

5137-5724-5963.notablePrerequisites: Marvin does not have summoning sickness.
5137-5724-5963.description:
Activate Marvin using Sage of the Maze's ability by tapping it, adding {1}{U}.
Activate Marvin using Morphling's ability by paying {U}, untapping it.
Repeat.

requires.n: Instant or Sorcery that creates one or more Creature Tokens

1636-5534--27.notablePrerequisites:
You have cast at least two spells this turn.
You have enough mana to cast the instant or sorcery.
Stella Lee does not have summoning sickness.
1636-5534--27.description:
Cast the instant or sorcery by paying its mana cost.
Holding priority, activate Stella Lee by tapping it, copying the instant or sorcery.
Resolve the copy of the instant or sorcery, creating at least one creature token.
When the creature token(s) enter the battlefield, Intruder Alarm triggers that many times, untapping all creatures.
Repeat from step 2.

uses.battlefieldCardState: as a copy of Archfiend of Despair

624-2607-2682.notablePrerequisites: Your life total is at least 2.
624-2607-2682.description:
Cast Dire Fleet Ravager by paying {3}{B}{B}.
When Dire Fleet Ravager enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing each player to lose a third of their life total, rounded up.
At the beginning of your upkeep, Archfiend of Despair and Phantasmal Image trigger.
Resolve the Archfiend of Despair trigger, causing each opponent to lose life equal to the life they lost this turn.
Resolve the Phantasmal Image trigger, causing each opponent to lose life equal to the life they lost this turn.
Each opponent loses the game due to having 0 or less life.

1035-2607.notablePrerequisites: An opponent has at least forty life.
1035-2607.description:
Cast Blessed Wind by paying {7}{W}{W}, causing an opponent with at least forty life to lose life until their life total is equal to twenty.
At the beginning of your end step, Archfiend of Despair triggers, causing each opponent to lose life equal to the life they lost this turn.
The opponent targeted by Blessed Wind in step 1 loses the game due to having zero or less life.

719-2034-3627.notablePrerequisites:
Avacyn's Collar attached to any creature you control.
"Human" chosen with Xenograft.
719-2034-3627.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the creature with Avacyn's Collar attached, adding {C}{C}.
When the creature dies, Avacyn's Collar triggers, creating a 1/1 Spirit creature token.
Activate Avacyn's Collar's equip ability by paying {2}, attaching it to the Spirit token.
Repeat.

930-1789-2232-5231.description:
Cast Universal Automaton by paying {1}.
Universal Automaton enters the battlefield, triggering Lathliss, creating a 5/5 Dragon creature token.
The Dragon enters the battlefield, triggering Cloudstone Curio, returning Universal Automaton from the battlefield to your hand.
Activate Thermopod's second ability by sacrificing the Dragon token, adding {R}.
Repeat.

618-3277-4872.description:
Cast Time Warp by paying {3}{U}{U}, causing you to take an extra turn.
Activate Kiki-Jiki by tapping it, creating a token copy of Izzet Chronarch with haste.
The token copy of Izzet Chronarch enters the battlefield, returning Time Warp from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat each turn.

1189-3575-4381.description:
Activate Aerie Ouphes by sacrificing itself.
Aerie Ouphes' persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Aerie Ouphes ability, dealing damage equal to its power to Grumgully.
Repeat.
